blocks.text: Striving to establish throughout the whole world the effort in the way of Rasulullah ﷺ, in order to correct one's own belief and deeds, and to bring the whole of mankind onto correct belief and deeds!

blocks.arabic_text: قَالَ اللهُ تَعَالي: (وَاللهُ يَدْعُوآ إِلي دَارِ السَّلَامِ ؕ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَّشَاءُ إِلي صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (O people,) Allah invites to the Home of peace (Jannah); and He guides whom He wills to the straight path.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (هُوَ الَّذِي بَعَثَ فِي اْلأُمِّيِّينَ رَسُولاً مِّنْهُمْ يَتْلُو عَلَيْهِمْ أَيَاتِهِ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الْكِتبَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ ق وَإِنْ كَانُوا مِنْ قَبْلُ لَفِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: He is the One who sent among the unlettered people a Messenger from among themselves; he recites His verses to them, purifies them, and teaches them the Book and wisdom - and indeed, before this they were in clear misguidance.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَذِيرًا ۞ فَلَا تُطِعِ الْكفِرِينَ وَجَاهِدْهُمْ بِهِ جِهَادًا كَبِيرًا۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (And) had We willed, We would have sent a warner to every town. So, (O Prophet,) do not obey these disbelievers; with this
